brainlife.desc: Constrained spherical deconvolution fit: fibre orientation distributions as spherical-harmonic NIfTI images per lmax, plus the response function.
brainlife.name: neuro/csd
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Fibre tracking (MRtrix, Trekker, PFT, SET) and SIFT/SIFT2/COMMIT filtering. Peak extraction and FOD visualisation.

**Not for:** Assuming a given lmax is present; files are optional and depend on the fit. Mixing MRtrix 0.2 and MRtrix3 FODs (tags differ) without checking conventions.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 24 Apps, output of 8 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.csd.json

identifying_risks: NIfTI headers or metadata may carry subject codes or dates
Rare lesions or anomalies can be recognisable in small samples
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed diffusion MRI without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Check headers and metadata for identifiers before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only as a group-averaged template
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states
